B-LINK Wi-Fi and 4G routers enable the wireless communication of the B-CONTROL MICRO with the B-CLOUD. They establish a reliable Wi-Fi or mobile network connection, allowing secure remote access to the compressor system. Intermediate pressure gauge Analog pressure gauges are installed at appropriate points of the compressor system and allow for easy monitoring of operating pressures. They support diagnostics and simplify maintenance work on the system. Separate intake buffer and condensate vessel In this closed system, the gas released during automatic condensate drainage is captured within the containers and fed directly back into the compression process. The system can also operate without a customer-supplied gas balloon. Its design is based on the combined container concept but consists of two separate vessels. The delivery scope also includes a suction solenoid valve and a compensation line for returning the collected gas to the intake side of the compressor. Purification systems. Changeover device PN 300/200 bar The PN 300/200 bar changeover device allows filling of cylinders with different operating pressures. Trolley set The trolley set enables easy and effortless transport of mobile compressor units. Equipped with pneumatic wheels, it ensures maximum mobility. Intake telescope The intake telescope allows relocating the intake area of compressor units to a place with clean ambient air. It is especially recommended where the installation site has elevated concentrations of pollutants such as CO or CO₂. Additional filling device PN 200 or PN 300 bar An existing filling connection can optionally be expanded by one or more additional connections with filling hoses of variable length. Compressor control The electronic control with monitoring electronics automatically shuts down the compressor at final pressure, records operating hours and oil pressure, displays the current status, and shows the battery charge directly on the control box. B-DRAIN automatic condensate drain The B-DRAIN condensate drain automatically discharges the water-oil mixture from the intermediate and final separators. Solenoid valves control the discharge individually and reliably. The gentle, controlled condensate release reduces pressure losses, saves energy, and increases efficiency. Compared to conventional solutions, B-DRAIN operates significantly more quietly. Downloads Product Brochure Premium Line Compressors EN (7.74 MB) Support Bauer dealers
